content.headline: Cloud AI vs Local AI — where does your data go?
content.body: This is a security decision, not a technology choice. Pick based on how sensitive the data is.
bullets: Cloud AI (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini): most powerful, but your data leaves the building
Local AI (Llama, Gemma, Phi): runs on your laptop, data stays private — ideal for sensitive files
Rule of thumb: classify the data first, then choose the tool
